title: Command a Match

objectives.text: Lose all HQs, production structures and engineering rigs.
Practice the chosen faction’s command ability.

scenario_exceptions.detail: Finite scripted enemy column 1: 3 rifles; normal adds 1 car, hard also adds 1 tank. Only enemy timing is scaled. Entry (100,52).
Finite scripted enemy column 2: 3 rifles; normal adds 1 car, hard also adds 1 tank. Only enemy timing is scaled. Entry (83,20).
Interface steps and their browser-local input records are separate from Go mission objectives. World completion alone does not certify selection, control groups, rally feedback or boarding input.

subtitles.speaker: Instructor Vale
subtitles.text: Win a short battle using standard unit, economy, fog and combat rules. Build forces and neutralize the opposing command and production buildings. Practice your chosen faction’s command ability once; finish by reviewing the debrief and replay. Each faction’s authored training assets and ability instructions use its normal roster.

subtitles.speaker: Operations
subtitles.text: Ability confirmed. Use the debrief and replay to inspect the battle when you finish.

subtitles.speaker: Watch
subtitles.text: Hostile column 1 is approaching the eastern road. Expected entry varies with difficulty; screen the marked approach.

subtitles.speaker: Watch
subtitles.text: Column 1 has entered. Its approach is east.

subtitles.speaker: Watch
subtitles.text: Hostile column 2 is approaching the northwestern pass. Expected entry varies with difficulty; screen the marked approach.

subtitles.speaker: Watch

subtitles.speaker: Instructor Vale
subtitles.text: Exercise complete. The same rules apply in skirmish and multiplayer.

subtitles.speaker: Instructor Vale
subtitles.text: Restart the checkpoint and keep the required training assets alive.

author: Codex authored scenarios during authorized quota takeover; Claude Opus 5.5 authored original helpers

tutorial_factions.instruction: Select the HQ and use Recon Sweep on explored terrain (35 Energy).
Select the starting Survey Drone and use Drone Recall (45 Energy), or Relay Boost while airborne (35 Energy).
Select command and use Disperse around visible infantry (45 Energy).
Select the active HQ and use Emergency Power (45 Energy).

art_status: Declared art references require the separately produced asset pack; no voice or illustration delivery is claimed here.
